user.title: Tuya SL-CE Videolock
user.description:
Connect with your Tuya Cloud project credentials.

**Where to find them**
1. Open your [Tuya Cloud project]({tuya_project_url}) (Overview / Basic Configuration).
2. Copy **Access ID** and **Access Secret**.
3. Choose the **region** that matches the project data center (this project uses **AZ / Americas**).

Also enable: *IoT Core*, *Smart Lock Open Service*, and *IoT Video Live Stream*.

Next step: we will list compatible locks (videolock / smart lock) linked to this project.

data_description.access_id: Client ID / Access ID from the Cloud project overview.
data_description.region: Must match the project data center (AZ → Americas / US).

select_device.title: Select your lock
select_device.description: Found **{device_count}** compatible device(s) (videolock / smart lock categories). Choose the lock to add.

data_description.device_id: Name, category and Device ID from your Tuya Cloud account.

manual_device.title: Enter Device ID
manual_device.description:
Cloud did not return a lock list (Smart Life account may be unlinked, or the list endpoint is empty).

Paste the **Device ID** from the Tuya Cloud console (Devices) or from Smart Life → device → Device Information.

For this apartment the SL-CE is typically `eba0b0f3d9b38977ed8b0a`.

Also confirm the app account is linked under [Cloud project]({tuya_project_url}) → Devices → Link Tuya App Account.
